lines.text: David takes refuge in the cave of Adullam, and about four hundred men rally around him.
David leaves his parents with the king of Moab, then obeys Gad and goes to the forest of Hereth.
Doeg the Edomite tells Saul he saw David come to Ahimelech at Ramah.
Saul's guards refuse to strike the priests, so Doeg kills eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.
Abiathar escapes to David, who tells him to hide in Moab and not be afraid.
